lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-intensity circular local maxima are arranged in a staggered grid posterior to the gill slits, with the highest concentration in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with the primary blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the upper edge and cast shadows on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Two elongated, high-luminance biological entities (remoras) are attached to the ventral-lateral region, one posterior to the gill slits and one anterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
